L1496@P16: In this section K is a field which is algebraically closed and complete with
L1497@P16: respect to an absolute value. We work with a variety X over K, by which
L1498@P16: we mean a reduced irreducible separated K-scheme of finite type. We let
L1499@P16: n := dim(X) and denote by Xan the Berkovich analytification of X.
L1500@P16: The space of real-valued (p, q)-forms on Berkovich analytic spaces was introduced by Chambert-Loir and Ducros in [CLD12] using analytic moment
L1501@P16: maps. In [Gub13] Gubler developed an approach based on algebraic moment maps in the case where the analytic space is the analytification of an
L1502@P16: algebraic variety. In that case both approaches lead to the same sheaves of
L1503@P16: forms. We will follow Gubler’s approach.
